title: Open direct-image finiteness for all-continuous algebraic-closure coefficients
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with the topology of the extended $\ell$-adic absolute value. Let $\Lambda$ be the commutative condensed ring with $\Lambda(S)=C(S,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ for every profinite set $S$, with pointwise ring operations [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Let $U,X$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting] and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ a quasi-compact open $k$-immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Pull the coefficient ring back from the point, $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ for $T=U,X$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. If $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_U})$ is bounded and each cohomology module has finite constant local models on a finite constructible stratification, then $Rj_*K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$ is bounded and each of its cohomology modules has finite constant local models on a finite constructible stratification [sk-def-sfb-constructible, det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Here $Rj_*$ is the ordinary total right derived module-object direct image [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. All continuous coefficient functions are admitted, with no assumption that their images lie in a single finite subextension. The statement asserts neither finite Tor amplitude nor any proper-image or compactification conclusion.

proof.text: The standing schemes, and their locally closed subschemes, are Noetherian and qcqs by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] and [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine], applied over the spectrum of the field. Write $\mathcal B(T)$ for bounded finite-constant-model constructible $B_T$-complexes. By [lem-sfb-continuous-qbar-constructible-generators], $\mathcal B(X)$ is triangulated and $\mathcal B(U)$ is generated under finitely many shifts, isomorphisms and triangles by $(a_!L)[0]$ with $a:S\hookrightarrow U$ locally closed and $L$ lisse over $B_S$. All objects used here are bounded below. On that subcategory the ordinary total derived functor is its bounded-below version [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], which is triangulated by [lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated] applied to the additive left exact module direct image. Its inverse image of $\mathcal B(X)$ is consequently a replete triangulated class. It suffices to put every such generator in that class.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open image: reduction to the finite lisse generators, using the all-continuous generator theorem.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-continuous-algcl-stratified-finite-models] to $L$ on $S$. Refine its finite stratification to a good one by [lem-sfb-noetherian-good-stratification-refinement], realizing each refined locally closed subset inside its original scheme stratum by a locally closed pullback, so the same finite-field models actually restrict along scheme morphisms. Since closures are unions of strata, a finite good stratification has an open layer and a closed complementary union of strata. The exact sequence $0\to v_!v^*M\to M\to i_*i^*M\to0$ of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed] therefore gives, by induction on the finite number of strata, a finite extension filtration with pieces $b_!(B_{S_b}\otimes_{A_{E_b,S_b}}L_b)$. At an open layer consisting of several disjoint strata, take their finite direct sum. Applying the exact $a_!$ (open extension followed by closed direct image) gives the corresponding finite triangle filtration of $a_!L$. Thus it is enough to treat $G=a_!b_!(B_V\otimes_{A_{E,V}}N)[0]$ with $b:V\hookrightarrow S$ locally closed and $N$ a lisse $A_{E,V}$-module for one finite $E$. This induction ends with the empty closed complement, which contributes zero.

source.place: Paragraph (3), source-stratum finite-field reduction; finite localization filtration written out.

proof.text:
Put $C=(a_!b_!N)[0]$. The old strata of $V$, together with the zero model off $V$, at each of the two immersions prove that $C$ is bounded constructible over $A_E$ by [lem-sfb-scalar-model-immersion-extension]. Locally free $N$ is flat; its derived coefficient extension is its ordinary one, by the field/free calculation of [lem-sfb-scalar-model-finite-flat-resolution]. Factor each of $a$ and $b$ as an open immersion followed by a closed immersion. Apply both formulas of [lem-sfb-condensed-support-projection-formula] with coefficient $A_E$ and with the other tensor factor the underlying $A_E$-complex of $B_U$. They give
$$B_U\otimes^L_{A_{E,U}}a_!b_!N\ \cong\ a_!b_!(B_V\otimes^L_{A_{E,V}}N)\ \cong\ G.$$
The comparison carries the $B_U$-action to the action through its restriction to $V$: on a local pure tensor it sends $b\otimes n$ to the same product $bn$. It is therefore an isomorphism of $B_U$-complexes, not just of the restricted $A_E$-complexes.

source.place: Paragraph (3), comparison of locally closed generators with actual scalar extension.

proof.text: We record the scalar calculation needed on the target. If $M\in\mathcal B_E(X)$ has cohomology in $[r,s]$, then $B_X\otimes^L_{A_{E,X}}M$ is in $\mathcal B(X)$ with the same interval. Indeed, refine the finitely many cohomology stratifications to one. On any resulting stratum, every cohomology sheaf is locally finite free, by the field case of [lem-sfb-scalar-model-finite-flat-resolution]. Such a sheaf is dualizable in degree zero: evaluation and coevaluation for a free module descend from its local trivializations. The finite truncation triangles of [lem-weil-pbc-truncation-triangle] and stability of dualizable objects in [lem-zl-condensed-dualizable-local-perfect-models] make $M$ dualizable on that stratum. The same node gives pro-etale local perfect scalar models over $E$. Coefficient extension commutes with restriction by the tensor-pullback isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and takes each such model to the identical finite scalar complex extended from $E$ to $\Omega$. A finite complex of vector spaces splits into its cohomology and contractible two-term summands, so these new models have finite-dimensional cohomology in the same interval. The computation is valid on every nonempty member of the cover; empty members are discarded. Exact restrictions to the finitely many strata detect zero objects, by iterating the open/closed exact sequence [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]. This proves both the global interval and finite constant local models on this finite stratification. No flatness of $B_X$ on all $A_{E,X}$-modules is claimed.

source.place: Paragraph (3), finite-field scalar model calculation; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach Theorem 4.13, via the cited local-perfect-model theorem.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sfb-rational-open-direct-image-constructible] with coefficient $E$, not its algebraic-closure alternative: $C$ is bounded constructible by step 3, the base field has characteristic different from $\ell$, and $j$ is quasi-compact open between the standing schemes. It gives $M=Rj_{*,A_E}C\in\mathcal B_E(X)$. Step 4 puts $B_X\otimes^L_{A_{E,X}}M$ in $\mathcal B(X)$. Now [lem-sfb-continuous-algcl-open-scalar-comparison] gives the canonical isomorphism
$$B_X\otimes^L_{A_{E,X}}M\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ Rj_{*,B}(B_U\otimes^L_{A_{E,U}}C)\ \cong\ Rj_{*,B}G.$$
This is precisely the ordinary derived direct image of the generator identified in step 3. Isomorphism invariance and the finite triangle filtrations of steps 1--2 give $Rj_{*,B}K\in\mathcal B(X)$ for every input $K$. Each construction involves finitely many bounds, so their minima and maxima give a finite bound for the resulting object. Identity and empty open immersions reduce to the identity and zero functors respectively.

The item's statement and blueprint are unchanged from side-live, and live still shows it unsplit (created 2026-10-21 by Q59, parent step 3). No repair note, no SGA. All cited ids exist, step uses match their citations, and there is no cycle. from.node=null is what the tooling requires: blueprint_refs ancestor returns None because the created.item chain ends in a Lean module. Maintainer note: the parent's from.node is det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images. Source: main-20261015 direct-images proof paragraph (3) covers only the filtered-union Q̄_ℓ. In Bhatt-Scholze, Lemma 6.8.2(2) and Lemma 4.3.7 rely on the colimit topology, and Example 7.1.7 contrasts it with the ℓ-adic topology. So the norm-topology C(-,Ω) case cannot cite filtered-union results, and the report's sequence counterexample is valid. Step 1: Noetherian/qcqs; the continuous generator theorem (smallest triangulated class, finitely many triangles); R⁺j_* triangulated by the derived-direct-image node; the preimage of ℬ(X) is replete triangulated. Step 2: stratified models on S, good refinement, and the open layer is the complement of the closed set ∪(cl Q_c∖Q_c) (checked). Induction with the open/closed exact sequence and exact a_! gives the triangle filtration. Step 3: immersion-extension at both immersions (E admissible, schemes Noetherian); the field case gives B⊗^L N = B⊗N; both support projection formulas apply with Λ=A_E; B-linearity holds because extension by zero keeps the action. Step 4: E-finite-free cohomology, truncation triangles, the dualizable node (stratum has finitely many components, R=E) gives local perfect E-models, these split over E, nonempty members detect the interval and strata detect zero. Valid but longer than needed. Step 5: rational-open finiteness with Λ=E (all hypotheses hold), then step 4, then β_C and step 3; identity and empty cases checked. New stratified-finite-models node: self-contained, statement only, not a duplicate (lisse-finite-coefficient-model is filtered-union; compact-matrix descent is a group statement; the generators node has no finite fields). Plausible via normal strata, profinite π₁, triviality of torsors on the universal cover by comparison with GL_n(C_ℓ), and Baire on the compact image. Edge cases T=∅, rank 0, constant modules. New open-scalar-comparison node: the explicitly pinned mate, the same form as lem-sfb-qlbar-direct-image-comparison but for the all-continuous ring; not a restatement of the item. Tested j=id, U=∅, and A¹⊃G_m (R¹ = Hom_cont(Z_ℓ,Ω)=Ω, as expected); carry-cochain H² counterexamples fail by Baire. No source exists for it; accepted as a statement-only WANTED obligation. Batch-5: both flags accepted. For the dualizable node I recomputed the full closure: its trf/pod nodes are definitions and generic topos, algebra and category lemmas (geometric inverse image exact, slice subtopos, henselian lifting, localization). The rational-open node is already cited by the parent step 2 and is finite-E finiteness; its pd/trf closure is normalization, Tate-twist, base-change and Koszul tools. Neither is a step of the trace formula or Poincaré duality. Tool uses accepted. No changes.
